objective: Provide structured knowledge regarding common trafficking route characteristics observed in narcotics investigations to support intelligence analysis, investigation planning and machine learning feature interpretation.

route_patterns.description: Movement of narcotic drugs across one or more state boundaries using road, rail, air or courier networks.
Distribution occurring within a single state through regional transportation networks.

risk_indicators: Repeated use of commercial transport services.
Movement inconsistent with declared occupation or purpose.
Use of multiple transport modes during a single journey.
investigation_guidelines: Compare origin and destination with intelligence records.
Coordinate with relevant enforcement agencies when multiple jurisdictions are involved.
references: United Nations Office on Drugs and Crime (UNODC) World Drug Report
